description:
Add a blog to the BenchBox website at https://benchbox.dev/blog/ using ABlog,
a Sphinx extension for blogging. This integrates seamlessly with the existing
Sphinx/Furo/MyST documentation setup, requiring minimal changes.

ABlog was chosen over alternatives (Hugo, Pelican, Jekyll) because:
- Uses existing Sphinx toolchain (no new build system)
- Inherits Furo theme for visual consistency with docs
- Supports Markdown via MyST (already configured)
- Integrates into existing GitHub Actions deployment
- Provides full blog features: RSS, archives, tags, categories
